rightsReview.basis: Bounded acquisition of official state legislative texts under the same documented basis as the closed programs: LFDA art. 14 frac. VIII (documented basis, not a legal conclusion). Verified 2026-11-13 before acquisition: robots.txt absent (404 HTML Not Found; absence of robots is NOT treated as permission by itself); no AI-agent or content-signal restrictions observed; no aviso legal, terms-of-use or reuse/IP prohibition located on home or category pages (absence of terms is NOT treated as express authorization by the owner); official state government library publishing direct PDF downloads (/documentos/{id}/pdf, inline); no blocks with default user agent.
